# build2 Ecosystem -- AI Reference

> Structured, AI-consumable reference for the build2 C/C++ toolchain: build
> system (b), package manager (bpkg), project manager (bdep), task runner
> (bx), and repository web interface (brep).

## Start here

- [SKILL.md](SKILL.md): Skill entry point -- activation hints, when-to-use table, quick orientation.
- [INDEX.md](INDEX.md): Ecosystem overview, full command lookup tables, and navigation links to all reference files. Read this first.
- [GLOSSARY.md](GLOSSARY.md): Cross-tool terminology.

## Tool references

- [b/README.md](b/README.md): Build system driver -- buildspec syntax, meta-operations, operations, key options.
- [b/b.md](b/b.md): Full b option reference.
- [bpkg/README.md](bpkg/README.md): Package manager -- key concepts, all commands, typical workflows.

- [bpkg/bpkg-cfg-unlink.md](bpkg/bpkg-cfg-unlink.md): bpkg-cfg-unlink -- unlink configuration.

- [bpkg/bpkg-rep-remove.md](bpkg/bpkg-rep-remove.md): bpkg-rep-remove -- remove repository from configuration.

- [bpkg/bpkg-rep-fetch.md](bpkg/bpkg-rep-fetch.md): bpkg-rep-fetch -- fetch list of available packages from repositories.
- [bpkg/bpkg-rep-create.md](bpkg/bpkg-rep-create.md): bpkg-rep-create -- create repository from a directory of package archives.

- [bpkg/bpkg-pkg-drop.md](bpkg/bpkg-pkg-drop.md): bpkg-pkg-drop -- drop package and its unused dependencies.
- [bpkg/bpkg-pkg-status.md](bpkg/bpkg-pkg-status.md): bpkg-pkg-status -- print status of one or more packages.
- [bpkg/bpkg-pkg-fetch.md](bpkg/bpkg-pkg-fetch.md): bpkg-pkg-fetch -- fetch package archive into the configuration.
- [bpkg/bpkg-pkg-unpack.md](bpkg/bpkg-pkg-unpack.md): bpkg-pkg-unpack -- unpack a fetched package archive.

- [bpkg/bpkg-pkg-configure.md](bpkg/bpkg-pkg-configure.md): bpkg-pkg-configure -- configure an unpacked package.
- [bpkg/bpkg-pkg-disfigure.md](bpkg/bpkg-pkg-disfigure.md): bpkg-pkg-disfigure -- disfigure (unconfigure) a configured package.
- [bpkg/bpkg-pkg-update.md](bpkg/bpkg-pkg-update.md): bpkg-pkg-update -- update (recompile) a configured package.
- [bpkg/bpkg-pkg-test.md](bpkg/bpkg-pkg-test.md): bpkg-pkg-test -- run the test suite of a configured package.
- [bpkg/bpkg-pkg-clean.md](bpkg/bpkg-pkg-clean.md): bpkg-pkg-clean -- clean build artifacts of a configured package.
- [bpkg/bpkg-pkg-install.md](bpkg/bpkg-pkg-install.md): bpkg-pkg-install -- install a built package to the configured install root.
- [bpkg/bpkg-pkg-uninstall.md](bpkg/bpkg-pkg-uninstall.md): bpkg-pkg-uninstall -- uninstall a previously installed package.
- [bpkg/bpkg-pkg-purge.md](bpkg/bpkg-pkg-purge.md): bpkg-pkg-purge -- remove a package that was fetched or unpacked but not configured.
- [bpkg/bpkg-pkg-verify.md](bpkg/bpkg-pkg-verify.md): bpkg-pkg-verify -- verify the integrity and structure of a package archive.
- [bpkg/bpkg-pkg-bindist.md](bpkg/bpkg-pkg-bindist.md): bpkg-pkg-bindist -- generate a binary distribution package (deb, rpm, etc.).
- [bpkg/bpkg-manifest-reference.md](bpkg/bpkg-manifest-reference.md): bpkg package manifest reference -- all manifest fields, types, and constraints.
- [bpkg/bpkg-dependency-negotiation.md](bpkg/bpkg-dependency-negotiation.md): bpkg dependency configuration negotiation -- how multi-package version constraints are resolved.
- [bpkg/bpkg-repository-types.md](bpkg/bpkg-repository-types.md): bpkg-repository-types -- archive, directory, and git repository types, structure, and URLs.
- [bpkg/bpkg-repository-signing.md](bpkg/bpkg-repository-signing.md): bpkg-repository-signing -- how to sign a repository and how signatures are verified.
- [bpkg/bpkg-argument-grouping.md](bpkg/bpkg-argument-grouping.md): bpkg-argument-grouping -- argument grouping facility for per-package option sets.
- [bpkg/bpkg-default-options-files.md](bpkg/bpkg-default-options-files.md): bpkg-default-options-files -- how and where default options files are loaded.

- [bdep/bdep-init.md](bdep/bdep-init.md): bdep-init -- initialize project in build configurations.

- [bdep/bdep-fetch.md](bdep/bdep-fetch.md): bdep-fetch -- fetch list of available project dependencies.
- [bdep/bdep-update.md](bdep/bdep-update.md): bdep-update -- update (build) project in build configurations.
- [bdep/bdep-test.md](bdep/bdep-test.md): bdep-test -- test project in build configurations.
- [bdep/bdep-clean.md](bdep/bdep-clean.md): bdep-clean -- clean project in build configurations.
- [bdep/bdep-status.md](bdep/bdep-status.md): bdep-status -- print status of project and/or its dependencies.
- [bdep/bdep-ci.md](bdep/bdep-ci.md): bdep-ci -- submit project test request to CI server.
- [bdep/bdep-release.md](bdep/bdep-release.md): bdep-release -- manage project version during release.
- [bdep/bdep-publish.md](bdep/bdep-publish.md): bdep-publish -- publish project to archive repository.

- [bdep/bdep-projects-configs.md](bdep/bdep-projects-configs.md): bdep-projects-configs -- specifying projects and configurations on the command line.

- [bx/bx.md](bx/bx.md): Full bx option reference.
- [brep/README.md](brep/README.md): Repository web interface -- key concepts, all commands, typical deployment workflows.
- [brep/brep-load.md](brep/brep-load.md): brep-load -- load repositories and package metadata into the package database.
- [brep/brep-clean.md](brep/brep-clean.md): brep-clean -- delete expired build records or expire/archive tenants.
- [brep/brep-migrate.md](brep/brep-migrate.md): brep-migrate -- create, migrate, or drop the package or build database schema.
- [brep/brep-monitor.md](brep/brep-monitor.md): brep-monitor -- detect and report delayed package builds.
- [brep/brep-request-handling.md](brep/brep-request-handling.md): brep request handling -- package submission, CI request, build artifact upload, and GitHub CI integration protocols.

## Guides

- [guides/packaging-guide-summary.md](guides/packaging-guide-summary.md): Third-party packaging guide -- concepts, workflow checklist, and steps 1-7 (repository setup through installation configuration).
- [guides/packaging-guide-testing.md](guides/packaging-guide-testing.md): Third-party packaging -- steps 8-10: writing tests, CI validation, releasing and publishing to cppget.org, common pitfalls.
- [guides/packaging-guide-review.md](guides/packaging-guide-review.md): Third-party package review process -- transition policy, initial/version/revision review procedures, authoritative checklist, outcome and email formats.
- [guides/packaging-guide-version-management.md](guides/packaging-guide-version-management.md): Third-party packaging version management -- new revision workflow, new upstream version workflow, version bump procedures.
- [guides/packaging-guide-antipatterns.md](guides/packaging-guide-antipatterns.md): Third-party packaging antipatterns -- common mistakes, what not to do, upstream patching guidelines.
- [guides/bpkg-package-name-version.md](guides/bpkg-package-name-version.md): bpkg package naming rules, version format, and dependency constraint syntax.
- [guides/build2-intro-concepts.md](guides/build2-intro-concepts.md): build2 concepts -- targets, scopes, modules, variables, operations.
- [guides/build2-buildfile-language.md](guides/build2-buildfile-language.md): Buildfile language reference -- syntax, directives, conditions, loops, out-of-source builds.
- [guides/build2-directives-patterns.md](guides/build2-directives-patterns.md): Buildfile directives (define, using, import, include, source, if/for/while, assert, run, dump) plus name wildcard patterns and target/variable attributes.
- [guides/build2-projects-advanced.md](guides/build2-projects-advanced.md): Advanced projects -- importation, library metadata, testing, installation, subprojects, diagnostics.
- [guides/build2-modules-bin.md](guides/build2-modules-bin.md): bin module -- binary target type hierarchy (lib, liba, libs, exe, obj, bmi).
- [guides/build2-modules-cc.md](guides/build2-modules-cc.md): cc module -- C-common infrastructure, DLL export, compilation database, toolchain detection.
- [guides/build2-modules-c.md](guides/build2-modules-c.md): c module -- C compilation, Objective-C, assembler.
- [guides/build2-modules-cxx.md](guides/build2-modules-cxx.md): cxx module -- C++ compilation, C++20 modules, cross-compilation, options reference.
- [guides/build2-modules-core.md](guides/build2-modules-core.md): Core modules reference -- config (hermetic builds), test (config.test, runners), install (layout, filtering, relocation).
- [guides/build2-modules-misc.md](guides/build2-modules-misc.md): in and bash modules -- .in template preprocessing, substitution symbols, .sh.in bash scripts.
- [guides/build2-module-version.md](guides/build2-module-version.md): version module -- version variables, integer encoding, snapshot versions, version header generation from .in templates.
- [guides/build2-project-config.md](guides/build2-project-config.md): Project configuration -- config directive syntax, variable declaration, types, nullable and required variables, config.build cache, hermetic builds, propagating values via macros or generated headers, configuration report attributes, command-line overrides, factoring config directives, bpkg package considerations.
- [guides/build2-targets-variables.md](guides/build2-targets-variables.md): Targets and variables reference -- built-in target type hierarchy (alias, dir, fsdir, group, file, doc, exe), C/C++ module target types (cxx, hxx, obj, liba, libs), target naming and qualification, variable types table, assignment operators, scope hierarchy (global/root/directory/target/prerequisite), built-in scope and global variables, built-in function families (builtin, string, integer, path, name, target, regex, json, process, filesystem) with per-function tables.
- [guides/testscript-summary.md](guides/testscript-summary.md): Testscript language reference -- integration, execution model, lexical structure, test/group scopes, commands.
- [guides/testscript-commands.md](guides/testscript-commands.md): Testscript variables, redirections, here-documents, output regex, cleanup, builtins table, and common patterns.
- [guides/build2-modules-autoconf.md](guides/build2-modules-autoconf.md): autoconf module -- processing config.h.in/cmake/meson files with builtin and project checks.
- [guides/build2-autoconf-project-checks.md](guides/build2-autoconf-project-checks.md): autoconf module -- authoring project-specific checks in build/autoconf/checks/.
- [guides/build2-autoconf-buildfile.md](guides/build2-autoconf-buildfile.md): autoconf module -- communicating check results to buildfiles via c.predefs.
- [guides/build2-autoconf-contributing-checks.md](guides/build2-autoconf-contributing-checks.md): autoconf module -- stylistic guidelines and PR format for contributing checks to the builtin catalog.
- [guides/kconfig-summary.md](guides/kconfig-summary.md): kconfig module -- overview, enabling, and full Kconfig language reference (config entries, dependencies, menus, choices).
- [guides/kconfig-integration.md](guides/kconfig-integration.md): kconfig build system integration -- loading files, generated config, module variables, and complete worked example.
- [guides/build2-module-hello.md](guides/build2-module-hello.md): custom build2 module reference -- module API, build2_hello_load entry point, init/boot functions, module_functions table, symbol export, library buildfile, manifest requirements, bootstrap modules.
- [guides/build2-module-dev-setup.md](guides/build2-module-dev-setup.md): build2 module development setup -- build-system-only quickstart, bdep split host/target workflow, three-config tool pattern, CI, release, global import override.
- [guides/install-bootstrap.md](guides/install-bootstrap.md): Installing and bootstrapping -- prerequisites, pre-built packages, and bootstrap steps 1-2 (all platforms).
- [guides/install-toolchain.md](guides/install-toolchain.md): Toolchain install step 3 -- stage, create bpkg configuration, install from repository, add modules, clean.
- [guides/install-upgrade.md](guides/install-upgrade.md): Upgrading an installed toolchain -- dirty upgrade (patch), staged upgrade (minor/major), recreating the bpkg configuration, default paths.

## HOWTO

- [HOWTO/README.md](HOWTO/README.md): Practical recipes indexed by topic.
- [HOWTO/troubleshooting.md](HOWTO/troubleshooting.md): Common error messages and resolutions for b, bpkg, bdep, bx, and brep.
- [HOWTO/alias-targets.md](HOWTO/alias-targets.md): PHONY-equivalent targets using alias{}.
- [HOWTO/buildfile-compile-options.md](HOWTO/buildfile-compile-options.md): Which compile/link options belong in a buildfile.
- [HOWTO/config-independent-build-graph.md](HOWTO/config-independent-build-graph.md): Keeping the build graph configuration-independent.
- [HOWTO/for-install-conflicts.md](HOWTO/for-install-conflicts.md): Resolving "already updated but [not] for install" errors.
- [HOWTO/generated-headers.md](HOWTO/generated-headers.md): Auto-generated C/C++ headers.
- [HOWTO/disable-shared-lib-per-platform.md](HOWTO/disable-shared-lib-per-platform.md): Disabling the shared library variant per platform.
- [HOWTO/update-for-test-install.md](HOWTO/update-for-test-install.md): Building only what is needed for test or install (update-for-test / update-for-install operations).
- [HOWTO/header-only-library.md](HOWTO/header-only-library.md): Binless (header-only) libraries.
- [HOWTO/library-provides-main.md](HOWTO/library-provides-main.md): Library that provides main().
- [HOWTO/link-pthread.md](HOWTO/link-pthread.md): Linking pthread.
- [HOWTO/link-system-library.md](HOWTO/link-system-library.md): Linking system libraries (-lm, -ldl, advapi32.lib).
- [HOWTO/optional-library-components.md](HOWTO/optional-library-components.md): Making library components optional.
- [HOWTO/target-metadata.md](HOWTO/target-metadata.md): Exporting metadata with executables and libraries.
- [HOWTO/assert-in-tests.md](HOWTO/assert-in-tests.md): Correctly using assert() in tests.
- [HOWTO/sanitize-tests.md](HOWTO/sanitize-tests.md): Sanitizing misbehaving tests with Testscript.
- [HOWTO/tests-extra-dependencies.md](HOWTO/tests-extra-dependencies.md): Tests with extra dependencies (separate test package).
- [HOWTO/convert-source-to-utf8.md](HOWTO/convert-source-to-utf8.md): Converting source file encoding to UTF-8.
- [HOWTO/package-naming.md](HOWTO/package-naming.md): Naming packages for third-party projects.
- [HOWTO/package-version-non-semver.md](HOWTO/package-version-non-semver.md): Projects that don't use semantic versioning.
- [HOWTO/package-version-none.md](HOWTO/package-version-none.md): Projects with no version at all.
- [HOWTO/third-party-private-headers.md](HOWTO/third-party-private-headers.md): Private implementation headers and generated config headers shared across internal targets in third-party packages.
- [HOWTO/multiple-configurations.md](HOWTO/multiple-configurations.md): Managing debug/release/sanitize configurations with bdep.
- [HOWTO/cross-compilation.md](HOWTO/cross-compilation.md): Setting up a cross-compilation configuration with target triplets.
- [HOWTO/ci-cd-setup.md](HOWTO/ci-cd-setup.md): Typical CI pipeline using bdep update/test.
- [HOWTO/migrate-from-cmake.md](HOWTO/migrate-from-cmake.md): Porting a CMake project to build2 buildfiles.
- [HOWTO/toolchain-dev-setup.md](HOWTO/toolchain-dev-setup.md): Setting up build2 for toolchain development.
- [HOWTO/bx-script.md](HOWTO/bx-script.md): Running .bx scripts and tasks with bx -- portable scripts and named task definitions.

## Scripts

- [scripts/verify-install.sh](scripts/verify-install.sh): Verify build2 toolchain installation.
- [scripts/new-package.sh](scripts/new-package.sh): Scaffold a new bpkg package directory.
- [scripts/probe-compiler.sh](scripts/probe-compiler.sh): Scan PATH for C++ compilers; print family, target triplet, and version.
- [scripts/check-manifest.sh](scripts/check-manifest.sh): Validate a bpkg manifest for required and recommended fields.
- [scripts/run-tests.sh](scripts/run-tests.sh): Run bpkg test --all in a bpkg configuration directory.
- [scripts/show-project-info.sh](scripts/show-project-info.sh): Display b info output in a labeled, consistent format.
- [scripts/check-links.sh](scripts/check-links.sh): Validate all relative Markdown links in checked-in files.

## Raw source

- [.submodules/build2-toolchain/](.submodules/build2-toolchain/): Git submodule containing the upstream .cli and .md source files. Run init-docs.sh to extract them to .docs/.
- [.submodules/build2-howto/](.submodules/build2-howto/): Git submodule containing the upstream HOWTO entries. Run init-docs.sh to extract them to .docs/HOWTO/.
- [.submodules/build2-brep/](.submodules/build2-brep/): Git submodule containing the upstream brep source files. Run init-docs.sh to extract them to .docs/brep/.
- [.submodules/libbuild2-autoconf/](.submodules/libbuild2-autoconf/): Git submodule containing the libbuild2-autoconf source and builtin check catalog. Run init-docs.sh to extract checks to .docs/libbuild2-autoconf/checks/.
- [.submodules/libbuild2-hello/](.submodules/libbuild2-hello/): Git submodule containing the libbuild2-hello reference module source. Run init-docs.sh to extract to .docs/libbuild2-hello/.
